author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I need the model registry to be fully automated so that every version is traceable and reproducible. Right now, I cannot verify if the forecast running in the stores is the exact experiment I validated. I want a system where any model deployment is logged with its full lineage and evaluation metrics, allowing me to rerun any past iteration instantly. The more automated this process is, the faster I can iterate on new features without breaking the current pipeline. I am asking for a complete, tool driven workflow that removes any manual steps in versioning and deployment tracking. This will ensure that when we retrain the weekly models, the provenance is clear and the team can trust the lineage of every prediction served to the ordering system.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that the more automated the process is, the faster they can iterate, indicating that exceeding the baseline request for full automation would increase their satisfaction.
